verified_defect.source: prepare_development.py final option text included the evaluation-only trailing instruction
verified_defect.scope: Contaminated substantive development loss and its target; single-letter task scoring never decoded option text.

task_relation.original_training: 8–22 numbered questions with answer text, not option letters. Variable substantive lengths; all assistant-body and end tokens supervised.
task_relation.task_evaluation: One original multiple-choice question and a single-letter answer; first answer position predicted from previous logits. Restricted-choice accuracy and full-vocabulary gold-answer NLL remain separate.
task_relation.mixed_candidate: One substantive row and one metadata-selected original single-question task per training video. Explicit ce_exponent=1 gives equal per-row loss weight; this is a changed shared objective, not an optimizer-isolation claim.

audited_code.masking: sft.py packer assistant bodies and end tokens, loss shift once, attention/label masks applied
audited_code.scorer: answer_alignment verifies native assistant header, stable one-token A/B/C/D mapping and gold identity; score_prediction separates full-vocab answer NLL from choice-only normalization
audited_code.frozen: Pinned native Qwen3-VL weights, same FP32 storage/BF16 compute, input manifests/processor; no optimizer instantiated in dense scorer
audited_code.checkpoint: dense scorer validates committed transaction then strictly loads model net before freezing; no optimizer dependency for model-only scoring

historical_scope: Both previous evidence manifests verified byte-for-byte; no prior result or threshold overwritten. The second-campaign NLL mean regression is0.618%, while4.260% is the upper confidence bound.
